keyEvents.text: Goal! Napoli 0, Lazio 1. Davide Frattesi (Lazio) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Tijjani Noslin following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Josip Sutalo (Lazio).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lazio. Diogo Leite replaces Josip Sutalo because of an injury.
Noa Lang (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lazio. Alfonso Pedraza replaces Nuno Tavares.
Second Half begins Napoli 0, Lazio 1.
Own Goal by Alfonso Pedraza, Lazio. Napoli 1, Lazio 1.
Substitution, Lazio. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
Substitution, Lazio. Manuel Lazzari replaces Romano Floriani Mussolini.
Billy Gilmour (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Antonio Vergara (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Kenneth Taylor (Lazio).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Napoli. Frank Anguissa replaces Billy Gilmour.
Substitution, Napoli. Lorenzo Lucca replaces Rasmus Højlund.
Substitution, Napoli. Matteo Politano replaces Antonio Vergara.
Alfonso Pedraza (Lazio) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lazio. Matteo Cancellieri replaces Davide Frattesi.
Substitution, Napoli. Giovane replaces Kevin De Bruyne.
